entries.title: The Surge
entries.definitive_edition: The Surge Complete Edition / all DLC on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with complete DLC content.

primary.version: Complete Edition / base game plus all DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC complete route is the best version because it covers the base game, A Walk in the Park, The Good, the Bad and the Augmented, and the smaller gear/booster DLC packs while retaining PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Surge on Steam or GOG and install the major DLC packs, especially A Walk in the Park and The Good, the Bad and the Augmented, before a full completion run.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; completeness depends on installing the DLC packs.

entries.title: The Surge 2
entries.definitive_edition: The Surge 2 Premium Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Premium Edition.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with all DLC including The Kraken.

primary.why: The Windows PC Premium Edition is the best route because it bundles the base game and Season Pass, including The Kraken expansion and gear/weapon packs, while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Surge 2 - Premium Edition on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Install the Season Pass content, then play The Kraken expansion as the major DLC chapter.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; use the Premium Edition for DLC completeness.
